name: cavalry-workspace
description: Cavalry local-first desktop finance app and supporting workspaces.

scripts.test: vitest run --config vitest.config.mjs && npm test --workspace @cavalry/finance-core && npm test --workspace @cavalry/action-review && npm test --workspace @cavalry/advisor && npm test --workspace @cavalry/companion-api && npm test --workspace @cavalry/sync-foundation && npm test --workspace @cavalry/desktop
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration --workspace @cavalry/companion-api && npm run test:integration --workspace @cavalry/desktop
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run verify:architecture && npm run licenses:runtime:check && npm run openapi:validate --workspace @cavalry/companion-api && npm run openapi:action-sanity --workspace @cavalry/companion-api && npm run gpt-instructions:check --workspace @cavalry/companion-api && npm run gpt-checkpointed-instructions:check --workspace @cavalry/companion-api
